story.value: The name iron comes from an Anglo-Saxon word of unknown origin.
The symbol Fe comes from the Latin word ferrum, meaning "firmness".
Iron is mentioned many times in the Old Testament of the Bible.

uses.value: Huge amounts of iron are used to make steel, an alloy of iron and carbon.
Steel is used to make paper clips, skyscrapers and everything in between.
Adding chromium to steel improves its durability and prevents rust, making stainless steel.
Iron sulfate is used to treat the blood disease anemia.
